questions.question: Which Babylonian gods are pictured being carried as burdens in Isaiah 46?
In contrast, what does God say he has done for Israel since birth?
options: Scattered them abroad among all of the far and distant nations
Carried them, and will carry and save them even to old age
Hidden away his face entirely from them because of their sin
Tested and tried them with both famine and with the sword
questions.answer: Carried them, and will carry and save them even to old age

questions.question: God declares the end from the beginning, saying his counsel shall stand.
Even to your old age I am he, and to gray hairs I will _____ you.
I am God, and there is no other; I am God, and there is none like me, declaring the end from the _____.
